Alerte Pluies Torrentielles

An official advisory issued to warn of intense and prolonged rainfall that may severely reduce visibility and increase risk of flooding and navigation hazards.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Alerte Pluies Torrentielles?

In this glossary, Alerte Pluies Torrentielles refers to: An official advisory issued to warn of intense and prolonged rainfall that may severely reduce visibility and increase risk of flooding and navigation hazards.

How is Alerte Pluies Torrentielles used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Attention tous les navires : Alerte pluies torrentielles en vigueur. Réduisez la vitesse, gardez une distance de sécurité et surveillez la visibilité."

Definition

An official advisory issued to warn of intense and prolonged rainfall that may severely reduce visibility and increase risk of flooding and navigation hazards.

Operational example

Attention all vessels: Torrential rain advisory in effect. Reduce speed, maintain safe distance, and monitor for reduced visibility.

Localized term

Alerte Pluies Torrentielles

Localized example

Attention tous les navires : Alerte pluies torrentielles en vigueur. Réduisez la vitesse, gardez une distance de sécurité et surveillez la visibilité.
